import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

from payhook.config import read_dotenv

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))


class ExtraTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parsing_edge_cases(self):
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".env", delete=False) as f:
            f.write('export A="x y"\nB=plain # note\nC="has # hash"\nnoequals\n')
        v = read_dotenv(f.name)
        self.assertEqual(v, {"A": "x y", "B": "plain", "C": "has # hash"})

    def test_doctor_hides_secrets_and_shows_sources(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            with open(os.path.join(tmp, ".env"), "w") as f:
                f.write('PAYHOOK_API_TOKEN="sekrit-token"\nPAYHOOK_TIMEOUT=5\n')
            r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "payhook", "doctor"], cwd=tmp,
                               capture_output=True, text=True,
                               env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": ROOT, "PAYHOOK_REGION": "us"})
        self.assertNotIn("sekrit-token", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_TIMEOUT = 5 [source: .env]", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_REGION = us [source: env]", r.stdout)
        self.assertIn("PAYHOOK_ENDPOINT = https://api.payments.example/v1 [source: default]", r.stdout)
